{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && mkdir -p specs/001-transactions/checklists && cat > specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Tagged Cache (TaggedCache)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous
- [x] Success criteria are measurable
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined
- [x] Edge cases are identified
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- Items marked incomplete require spec updates before `$speckit-clarify` or `$speckit-plan`
- Validation run 2026-10-17: all items pass. FR-001/FR-002/FR-003 name the public construct and operation names (TaggedCache, put, get, invalidate, maxsize) because the milestone text fixes the public API surface; these are interface names from the frozen requirements, not implementation choices. No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers: the single ambiguity (Claim-A variant label vs requirement text) was resolved in Assumptions per the rule that the latest requirement text overrides older design notes.
EOF
echo WROTE_CHECKLIST; printf '{
  "feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"
}
' > .specify/feature.json && cat .specify/feature.json && echo --- && ls specs/001-transactions specs/001-transactions/checklists"}
